verdicts.reason: The provided desktop and mobile screenshots show a zero baseline with ticks from 0 to 120 and bars for monthly values 100–112.

The script calculates totals and month-over-month changes from embedded monthly data, but the workflow trace does not establish that this data matches the source CSV; the rule-judge log also reports aggregate metadata and runtime self-validation failures.
Screenshots show labeled month and revenue axes, point units, values above bars, and a source data table with monthly changes.
The visible “What we fixed” note describes the axis baseline, monthly versus cumulative data, corrected 12% growth claim, and labels and units.
The artifact includes an HTML table with numeric monthly revenue, month-over-month changes, and cumulative totals.
Visible page text identifies revenue in points and names revenue.csv as the source.
